title: The Lion Who Wanted To Be A Teacher
custom_script:
# Scene: jungle
Teddy: {gasp} Peddy, look! A *lion* is coming! {hide} [surprised, point, whisper]
Lion: {walk-to} Don't be scared. I want to be a *teacher*! [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: {haan} A lion teacher? Who will be your *students*? [suspicious, hips]
Lion: {laugh} You two! Follow me to class! [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: {uff} I knew this jungle trip was a bad idea. [sad, shrug, fail]
# Scene: jungle classroom
Lion: {pace} Lesson one. How to *roar*! [normal, think, calm]
Lion: {angry} ROAAAR! [angry, point, shout, angry]
Peddy: {scared} {step-back} That was very *loud*, sir. [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: {hmm} Can we learn *math* instead? [suspicious, think]
Lion: {think} Okay. Two students… {sniff} minus two students… equals *lunch*! [suspicious, hips]
Peddy: {aah} Teddy, RUN! {run} [surprised, wave, shout, footsteps]
# Scene: jungle
Lion: {chase} Come back! Class is not over! [angry, point, shout, footsteps]
Teddy: {jump} I'm skipping school *forever*! {climb} [surprised, wave, excited, boing]
Lion: {cry} Nobody wants to learn from me… [sad, shrug, cry]
Peddy: {walk-to} {hug} Okay, okay. Teach us *dancing*! [happy, wave]
Lion: {yay} {dance} Best *class* ever! [happy, wave, excited, applause]
